title: Open your eyes. No. Jesus! If I fell over a cliff that
html_source:
Can’t be a physical cliff – Sandymount Strand is flat – but it refers to the Berkeley philosophy of immaterialism – opening his eyes, Stephen may well find nothing, that the world is not there.

Father and son is on Stephen’s mind – Jesus was God in space and time and Hamlet had a couple of issues with his da !

Campbell, J. Mythic Worlds, Modern Words: On the Art of James Joyce, p. 67.
